body.translated_text: <s>Āryacaturdharmanirdeśasūtram</s> (The Noble Sūtra on the Teaching of the Four Dharmas)
(The sūtra teaching the four counter-forces, which are the means for purifying sin)

body.text:
(kha)
saṃskṛte punaruddhāritam bhāratīyabhāṣāyām - āryacaturdharmanirdeśaṃ nāma mahāyānasutram /
body.translated_text:
(kha)
Restored again in Sanskrit from the Indian language — the <s>Mahāyāna</s> sūtra called <s>Āryacaturdharmanirdeśa</s> (Noble Teaching of the Four Dharmas).

body.text: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ evaṃ mayā śrutam - ekasmin samaye bhagavān buddhaḥ trāyastriṃśadeveṣu sudharmādevasabhāyāṃ sārddhaṃ pañcānāṃ bhikṣuśatānāṃ mahāsaṃghena, saṃbahulaiḥ maitreyamañjuśryādibodhisattvairmahāsattvairviharatisma / tasmin samaye bhagavān buddhaḥ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvaṃ maitreyamuddiśyopadiṣṭavān -
body.translated_text: Homage to all <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>. Thus have I heard: At one time, the Blessed <s>Buddha</s> was dwelling among the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> (Thirty-three) gods in the divine assembly hall of <s>Sudharmā</s>, together with a great assembly of five hundred <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks) and with many <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas</s> (great beings) such as <s>Maitreya</s>, <s>Mañjuśrī</s>, and others. At that time, the Blessed <s>Buddha</s> addressed the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Maitreya</s> and taught:

body.text: caturbhirmaitreya! dharmaiḥ samanvāgato bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ kṛtopacitaṃ pāpamabhibhavati / katamaiścaturbhiḥ? yaduta vidūṣaṇāsamudācāreṇa, pratipakṣasamudācāreṇa, pratyāpattibalena, āśrayabalena ca / tatra vidūṣaṇāsamudācāro 'kuśalaṃ karmādhyācarati, tatraiva tatraiva ca vipratisārabahulo bhavati / tatra pratipakṣasamudācāraḥ kṛtvā 'pyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale karmaṇyatyarthābhiyogaṃ gataḥ / pratyāpattibalaṃ saṃvarasamādānādakaraṇasaṃvaralābhaḥ / tatrāśrayabalaṃ buddhaḥdharmasaṃghaśaraṇagamanamanutsṛṣṭabodhicittatā ca / subalavatsaṃniśrayeṇa na śakyate pāpenābhibhavitum / ebhirmaitreya !caturbhidharmaiḥ samanvāgato bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ kṛpopacittaṃ pāpamabhibhavatīti //
body.translated_text: O <s>Maitreya</s>! A <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> (great being) endowed with four <s>dharmas</s> (principles) overcomes sin that has been committed and accumulated. Which four? Namely: through the practice of remorseful confession, through the practice of the antidote, through the power of resolve, and through the power of reliance. Therein, the practice of remorseful confession is that when one has committed an unwholesome action, one becomes full of contrition regarding that very act again and again. Therein, the practice of the antidote is that even after having committed unwholesome action, one engages with utmost effort in wholesome action. The power of resolve is the obtaining of restraint through the undertaking of moral discipline and non-commission. Therein, the power of reliance is taking refuge in the <s>Buddha</s>, <s>Dharma</s>, and <s>Saṃgha</s>, and not abandoning the mind of awakening (<s>bodhicitta</s>). By relying on a strong (foundation), one cannot be overcome by sin. O <s>Maitreya</s>! A <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> endowed with these four <s>dharmas</s> overcomes sin that has been committed and accumulated.

body.text: bodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ sūtramidaṃ sadā paṭhanīyaṃ (vācayitavyaṃ) svādhyāyitavyaṃ cintayitavyaṃ subahulaṃ bhāvayitavyaṃ ca / anena duścaritāni phalaṃ nābhinirvartiṣyante / evaṃ bhagavān upadiṣṭavān / bodhisattvena mahāsattvena maitreyeṇa taiśca bhikṣubhiḥ bodhisattvaiḥ śatakratvādidevaputraiḥ sarvasampannaparimaṇḍalena ca āptamanasā bhagavataḥ pravacanamabhinanditam /
body.translated_text: This sūtra should always be recited, read aloud, studied, reflected upon, and extensively cultivated by <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas</s>. By this, misdeeds will not come to fruition. Thus the Blessed One taught. The <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Maitreya</s>, those <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), the <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, the <s>devaputras</s> (divine sons) such as <s>Śatakratu</s> (Indra) and others, and the entire complete assembly, with joyful minds, rejoiced in the teaching of the Blessed One.
Thus concludes the <s>Mahāyāna</s> sūtra called <s>Āryacaturdharmanirdeśa</s> (The Noble Teaching of the Four Dharmas).

body.text: bhāratīyopādhyāyasurendrabodhinā mahālocāvā - vandejñānasenena cānūditaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ ca /
body.translated_text: Translated and established by the Indian teacher <s>Surendrabodhi</s> and the great translator <s>Vandejñānasena</s>.
